test_repository.description: Explicit dedicated repository URL or unambiguous existing checkout with authorized remote. Never a credential-bearing URL.

local_checkout.description: Optional verified existing checkout for test_repository.

plugin_revision.description: Resolve committed source HEAD at run start or explicitly supplied revision to full SHA.

source_mode.description: Dirty requires explicit authorization and hashed package snapshot/diff; never claim ordinary HEAD testing.

scope.description: Absent/empty selections mean full; nonempty phases and cases intersect. Missing prerequisite work is not authorized implicitly.

run_id.description: Existing campaign identity for an explicitly requested continuation; fresh identity otherwise allocated after discovery.

variants.description: Explicit case-to-variant selection; optional variants require selection. Must agree with phase/case scope and current catalog. Omitted selects required core only.

title: TextStats non-secret run inputs, version 1
description: Coordinator configuration only. Tokens, credential paths and credential handoff are not fields. Missing/blank repository must yield the documented missing-input action before writes.
